description: This file defines the 'Sending' class, which manages the process of sending signals/messages, handling their acknowledgements, monitoring success/failure, and logging. It also includes methods for exception handling and integrating with monitoring systems within a messaging or connectivity framework.

classes.name: Sending
classes.description: A class representing a message being sent with handling for acknowledgements, monitoring, and exception processing within a messaging framework.

methods.name: Sending
methods.description: Constructor for the Sending class, initializing with context, response future, connection ID resolver, and a logger.

methods.name: monitorAndAcknowledge
methods.description: Sets up a monitoring chain for the response, converting exceptions and handling acknowledgements.

methods.name: acknowledge
methods.description: Creates an acknowledgment response if necessary, dealing with null responses.

methods.name: getNullAckException
methods.description: Returns an exception indicating a null acknowledgement response was received.

methods.name: monitor
methods.description: Monitors the response and triggers appropriate monitoring actions based on the response type.

methods.name: isAcknowledgement
methods.description: Checks if a response is an acknowledgement.

methods.name: isTargetIssuesLiveResponse
methods.description: Determines if the target issues a live response acknowledgment.

methods.name: monitorLiveResponse
methods.description: Initiates monitoring for a live response.

methods.name: handleException
methods.description: Handles exceptions by monitoring send failure and converting exceptions into acknowledgements if appropriate.

methods.name: monitorSendFailure
methods.description: Logs and monitors failures during sending, differentiating between runtime exceptions and other failures.

methods.name: convertExceptionToAcknowledgementOrNull
methods.description: Converts an exception into an acknowledgment, or returns null if auto acknowledgment isn't configured.

methods.name: getRootCause
methods.description: Recursively retrieves the root cause of a throwable, especially handling CompletionException.
